- Milk, about 200 ml, whole: ~125 kcal, 6.5 g protein, 9.5 g carbs, 6.5 g fat.

Eaten: about 555 kcal. Subtracting the leftover yolk (~10 kcal, ~0.5 g protein, ~0.8 g fat) from the served macros gives about 25.5 g protein, 46 g carbs and 32 g fat.
